answer: Beacon spot-check plus compute heartbeat: each epoch a public beacon samples 10% of identities. A sampled identity must prove live compute in one hour, or its 50-unit deposit is slashed and it is frozen. A nebula of 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 units; about 100 are caught per epoch, burning 5,000 units, earning nothing. The check is a velvet rope: an honest agent pays once, and its normal work mirrors the heartbeat, so its rewards are never diluted.
